title: Omni Foundation Qualification Record
description: Formal owner-attested qualification record for the Omni foundation gate (OMNI-IMP-0.0.0.13). Separates technical CI outcomes from governance approval. Binds the record to the exact source commit and evidence set.

commit_sha.description: Exact 40-character lowercase Git commit SHA that was qualified.

technical_status.description: Result of the full CI validation run (fmt, clippy, build, test). Technical outcome, separate from formal qualification.

verified_item_count.description: Number of mandatory inventory items with Verified status at the time of qualification. Must be <= total_mandatory_items.

total_mandatory_items.description: Total count of mandatory inventory items (those with COMP- or ADR- prefixes, excluding N/A items like COMP-018).

verified_gaps.description: List of mandatory items that are not yet Verified. Empty array means all mandatory items are Verified. Must be consistent with verified_item_count and total_mandatory_items: verified_item_count + len(verified_gaps) <= total_mandatory_items.

formal_status.description: Governance-level formal sign-off status. 'approved' means the project owner has attested the qualification record for the stated commit and scope. 'pending' means Alternative C decision is in effect but formal attestation is outstanding. 'rejected' means the qualification was not approved.

attester.description: Identity of the person/body attesting formal qualification (e.g., email address or username). Must not be empty when formal_status is 'approved'.

attestation_date.description: ISO 8601 date-time when the formal attestation was recorded. Must be present when formal_status is 'approved'.

items.description: Human-readable reason why each remaining mandatory item is blocked. Corresponds to discrepancy entries (D-001, D-002, etc.). Provides transparency for why items are not Verified.

blocked_reasons.description: Why mandatory items are not yet Verified. Each entry should reference the relevant discrepancy resolution pattern.

spec_digest.description: SHA-256 digest of the spec tree at qualification time, to prevent post-hoc changes to the normative specification base.

adr_revision.description: The ADR revision number or commit reference that approved the Alternative C decision. Links the qualification record to the authoritative design decision.

ci_evidence.description: References to CI workflow runs that validated the technical status. Enables traceability from the qualification record to exact job outcomes.

linux_run_id.description: GitHub Actions run ID for the validate-linux job.

macos_run_id.description: GitHub Actions run ID for the validate-macos job.

windows_run_id.description: GitHub Actions run ID for the validate-windows job.

technical_conclusion.description: Overall conclusion of the technical CI validation run.

artifact_urls.description: URLs to the CI job artifacts (logs, reports, SBOMs, checksums).

ci_evidence.description: Optional references to CI runs that supported the technical_status. At minimum, the run IDs and conclusions should be present when the technical_status is 'passed' or 'failed'.

attester.description: Email-style identifier for the attester. Required when formal_status is 'approved'.

attestation_date.description: ISO 8601 date-time when the formal attestation was recorded. Required when formal_status is 'approved'.

attester.description: Identity may be present but is not required when formal_status is 'pending' (Alternative C in effect).

attestation_date.description: May be present but not required when formal_status is 'pending'.

items.description: Must explain why qualification was rejected. At minimum one entry required.

attester.description: Identity of person/body who rejected the qualification.
